headline: Clean: the Blue Account referral ($35 + $30 = $65) is the unique best combined bonus for a $600 deposit, and the referral window allows it.
solution_check: Tenure counts from Green Fee-Free opened 09/14/2025 (61 days). Combined bonuses that a $600 deposit qualifies for: Blue 65 ($500), Green Fee-Free 55 ($300), Green 50, Light Blue 50, Light Green 40. Evergreen ($750), Purple and Dark Green ($1,000), and Bluest ($2,000) are out, and Gold Years needs age 62+. Window: the COMPLETE referral on 11/04 is 10 days old and IN_PROGRESS 11/10 is the only one inside 9 days, so a slot is open under either the bonus or the referral count. Blue Account matches gold[2]; the gold replays cleanly.
prior_note: The prior review also rated this task clean.
notes: The customer's account of the referral history ('maybe 9 days ago... a few days before that') differs from the DB, which is an intended verification check. submit_referral stores the account_type string the user types; the script tells the user to append 'Account'. get_referrals_by_user is a non-discoverable read and logs nothing.
